newsitem.title: USA: Golden Eagle says finds gold in Bolivia.
newsitem.headline: Golden Eagle says finds gold in Bolivia.

text.p: Golden Eagle International said on Friday initial results from an exploratory mine shaft in Cangalli, Bolivia showed significant gold content.

Golden Eagle said in a statement its subsidiary Golden Eagle Bolivia Mining had reached the mine's paleocanal, an ancient river bed about 1200 feet below the surface of the mine entrance. It was known to contain significant deposits of gold, Golden Eagle said.
Golden Eagle also said it would pay about $1 million to buy necessary mining and processing equipment from a Bolivian mining company.
"It has been very rewarding to receive the reports from the samples that the interface zones are as mineralized as our people had estimated," Golden Eagle President Mary Erikson said in a statement.
